name.value: Buena Vista by the Sea Motel

description.value: Buena Vista by the Sea is an adults-only waterfront motel in Qualicum Beach on the east side of Vancouver Island, offering eight renovated suites—each with a full kitchen and ocean views. Upper suites feature private balconies with panoramic sea vistas, while lower suites open directly onto a manicured lawn at the water's edge. The motel sits amid biking routes, nature trails, golf courses, and wildlife sanctuaries, making it a convenient base for mid-island touring.

address.value: 3285 Island Highway West, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 2C6
